parameters.name: DefaultVersion
parameters.description: Specifies whether to query the default version.

parameters.name: DetailFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query detailed template configuration information. Valid values:

- true: Queries detailed template configuration information. In addition to basic template information, detailed configuration information is returned, such as the image ID and system disk size.

- false: Queries only basic template information, such as the template ID, template name, and default version.

Default value: true.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateId
parameters.description:
The launch template ID.

You must specify LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to determine the template.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateName
parameters.description:
The launch template name.

You must specify LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to determine the template.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateVersion
parameters.description: One or more launch template version numbers.

parameters.name: MaxVersion
parameters.description: The maximum version number used to filter query results. Use this parameter together with MinVersion to query version information within the range between the minimum and maximum version numbers.

parameters.name: MinVersion
parameters.description: The minimum version number used to filter query results. Use this parameter together with MaxVersion to query version information within the range between the minimum and maximum version numbers.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the launch template list.

Minimum value: 1. 

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page when paging is used. 

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the launch template.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
